note: The two sets are effectively identical in content: the same 19 claims, same values, same quotes, with only trivial wording differences ("structural member" vs "member" for HSS4X4X1/4) and ordering. Both bind W10X15 to "First Floor Framing" although it appears in Structural Section 1, both duplicate the PL3"X1/4" and W10X15 facts under two names, and both use vague entities such as "dimension | length" and "component | specification". Both also omit notable members shown on the page (W8X13, HSS4X6X1/4, L3x3x1/4").
remarks: Both extractions treat every dimension string as "dimension | length", losing which member, spacing or offset each dimension belongs to (e.g. 6'-0" and 5'-0" are horizontal grid spacings, 8"/6"/10" are small offsets). The claim "First Floor Framing | member section | W10X15" is unsupported: W10X15 is labeled in STRUCTURAL SECTION 1, and the page part shows sections, not a first-floor framing plan. W8X13, HSS4X6X1/4 and L3x3x1/4" are clearly labeled on the page but captured by neither set.
